report.title: Support OAuth 2.1 authorization for the built-in MCP server (ChatGPT custom connectors)
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate. #6372 is a broader Home Assistant request that was auto-closed as stale; #6495 fixed the well-known HTML fallback. Neither asks for native OAuth for the ChatGPT connector flow.

### What problem would this solve?

The MCP endpoint only accepts a static PAT (`Authorization: Bearer <PAT>`), but ChatGPT's custom connector offers only "OAuth" or "No auth" — there is no field for a static header, and putting a token in the URL is rejected. So ChatGPT cannot connect to a self-hosted Memos unless the instance is left unauthenticated.

On **26.11.0** (`neosmemo/memos:26.11.0`), an unauthenticated `POST /mcp` returns **HTTP 200**: `tools/list` gets the full 36-tool catalog, `tools/call` gets `{"isError": true, "text": "401 Unauthorized"}`. There is no `WWW-Authenticate` header and `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` is 404. ChatGPT starts the OAuth flow only on **401 + `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=...`**, so the linking UI never appears and every tool call fails at the JSON-RPC layer. Reporting auth failures as HTTP 200 also confuses other spec-compliant clients.

### What would you like to happen?

Add OAuth 2.1 authorization to the built-in MCP server, **keeping static PAT support unchanged**:

1. **Minimum (small change, biggest win)**: return 401 + `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=...` for unauthenticated `/mcp`, serve RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata, and return 404 (not SPA HTML) on `/oauth/*`. Optionally allow pointing at an external authorization server (Authentik, Keycloak, ...) so Memos only validates tokens.
2. **Full**: a built-in authorization server — RFC 8414 metadata, RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration, an authorize/consent screen reusing the Memos session, PKCE S256 + refresh tokens, `resource` (RFC 8707) and `iss` (RFC 9207), tokens mapped to existing user/PAT permissions, behind an off-by-default toggle.

### Additional context

- Memos 26.11.0, official Docker image, self-hosted behind HTTPS; the behavior above was measured against the container directly (no proxy).

plan.reported_actual: An unauthenticated POST to the /mcp endpoint returns HTTP 200 instead of 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header, and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource returns 404, so ChatGPT custom connectors cannot start an OAuth flow.
